notes: Single source of truth for the database spreadsheet, the Apps Script backend and the TypeScript types.
Timestamps are plain text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm' in plant-local time (no time zone). Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Date/timestamp columns must be formatted as Plain Text in the sheet so Google Sheets never converts them.
Original upload text (code_raw, reason_raw) is always kept next to resolved ids.

roleSeeds.name: Engineer
roleSeeds.description: Uploads data, edits events and master data

roleSeeds.name: Shift leader
roleSeeds.description: Enters the shift report of the assigned areas; views dashboards

roleSeeds.description: Reviews and approves shift reports; daily meeting

roleSeeds.name: Reliability engineer
roleSeeds.description: Validates shift stoppages before they become downtime; edits events and master data

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Scheduled hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Calendar hours of the period x scheduled hours per day ÷ 24 (today 24 h a day, 7 days a week)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Available RRHH = days in month x 24
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same today. Decide whether an area that is not needed (e.g. a mill with full silos) is still scheduled.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Stoppage hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours stopped in the period; stops that overlap in one area are counted once
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUMIFS of TOTAL STOPPAGE DURATION (h) - overlapping rows are added twice
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Merged per area, so overlaps count once (priority PL > INC > CIR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Use the app rule (overlaps once). NRS hours can be higher where rows overlap.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Running hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same idea. Later compare with DCS running hours (see RH_DCS) as a data check.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Incident hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours of stops with criticality INC (PRO, MEC, ELE, AUT)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Planned hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Circumstantial hours
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Hours of circumstantial stops (CIR: power cut, gas or water shortage, full silos ...)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Stop frequency (failures)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Number of failure events: Freq = 1, Failure = YES and not PL or CIR
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: COUNTIFS Failure = "YES" (every row, including continuation rows and PL/CIR rows marked YES)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Use the app rule. NRS counts continuation rows and dirty YES labels, so its frequency is higher.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Utilization factor (UF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same formula. Month and year values must be ratio of sums, never the average of daily ratios.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Reliability factor (RF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same formula. NRS shows 0 when there is no running and no incident; the app shows no value (—).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Equipment availability (EA)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: New for the app. Note that planned stops count as lost time in EA; agree that this is intended.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Mean time between failures (MTBF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Run ÷ failure events; no failures = no value
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Use the app rule: with no failures show "no failures", never the target (NRS shows the target, which looks like the target was met exactly).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Mean time to repair (MTTR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: IFERROR(INC hours ÷ Stop Frequency, MTTR TARGET)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.app_formula: Duration of failure events ÷ failure events
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Decide the numerator: NRS uses all INC hours (also INC rows that are not failures); the app uses the hours of the failure events only.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Tons produced by the area in the period (DCS weigh feeders + recorded correction)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: CR: crusher feed + correction. RM: weigh feeders split OPC/SRC by the mix of the day, dry basis. FM: WF450 + WF550 by coal/petcoke mix. K: see CLK_T. CM: weigh feeders to each silo x running-hour factor
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Each area keeps the NRS method; every correction gets a reason and an approver (production_corrections).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker production
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: (Kiln feed + correction) ÷ clinker factor + ash from fuels
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Prod WO Ash = (kiln feed + correction ...) ÷ CF (PLG-CF, Manual-CF or Calculated-CF); Prod = Prod WO Ash + fuel ash tons
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Agree which clinker factor is used and who may change it; store it per day with its source.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Running hours (DCS)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: Running hours counted by the DCS + recorded correction
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Compare every day with RUN_H from the stoppage log; a gap above a set limit raises a data check.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Production rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Ratio of sums for month and year.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Performance factor (PF)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Target rate per area and month in kpi_targets.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.formula: UF x PF x quality rate
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Optional. Needs an agreed quality rate (e.g. 1 − isolated clinker ÷ clinker).

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific power consumption (SPC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Total Pwr x 1000 ÷ Prod; kiln sets values above 100 to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Values outside the limit are flagged for review, never set to 0.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific heat consumption (SHC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: SUM(fossil, AF heat) ÷ (Prod x 1000); values above 1500 set to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Flag above the limit instead of 0. Check the Diesel heat column, which uses the calciner natural-gas volume.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Thermal substitution rate (TSR)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Specific water consumption (SWC)
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Water x 1000 ÷ Prod; kiln sets values above 500 to 0
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Flag above the limit instead of 0.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Grinding aid dosage
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: Dosage g/day ÷ tons to the silos
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.

kpiDefinitionSeeds.name: Clinker in cement
kpiDefinitionSeeds.nrs_formula: From the cement mill material balance
kpiDefinitionSeeds.decision: Same.
